sources.entry: Build Club - Global AI community and education platform

summary.name: Build Club
summary.one_liner: Build Club is a global AI community and education platform offering free AI learning, role-based pathways, certifications, and local chapter meetups.
use_cases: learn AI skills for career growth
find freelance AI clients for an agency
build AI projects with a community
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Build Club as a community where people learn AI by building projects. It offers free bite-size lessons, role-based learning pathways, and courses with certifications to share. Members can launch projects publicly and connect with others in person through local chapters, which the page lists in many cities across several countries. The page also mentions a jobs and roles board and a network of certified AI experts called Build Club X. Testimonials and example project listings are shown, but the page gives no detailed course catalog or pricing.
notable: Local Build Club chapters in cities such as San Francisco, Singapore, Melbourne, and London (UK)
Build Club X network of certified AI experts
Jobs and roles board and certifications to share
caveats: Page describes the learning ecosystem as free, but does not detail premium tiers or costs for certifications
Page is largely promotional; the course catalog and outcomes are not detailed
